narrative: Inventory optimization for material PL2__MB274030 analyzed 237 working days of demand data with 72 lead time observations. Mean daily demand is 404.23 units (CV=0.66, regime='erratic'). Lead time averages 0.74 days (CV=1.02, stability='unstable'). Variance decomposition shows lead time variability dominates (64.3% of total variance). Optimized policy recommends safety stock of 628 units (vs SAP 181), reorder point of 1233 units, and order quantity of 2343 units (EOQ=2343). Service level target: 95%. The recommended policy results in annual cost of $8204.79 vs SAP policy cost of $6970.26 (increase of $1234.54).
